name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Iranian leaders demand U.S. pay for war damage or will keep Strait of Hormuz closed
changes.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard insisted that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the U.S. complies with a list of demands, including paying for war damage. Imtiaz Tyab reports on the latest in a series of mixed messages from the regime.

changes.title: Gas prices stubbornly stuck, up more than $1 since war with Iran started
changes.summary: The cost of the war with Iran on taxpayers continues to grow, not only to finance the Pentagon's plans, but at the pump. Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: Oil prices rise amid uncertainty over U.S.-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
changes.summary: Oil was mixed as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not be coming anytime soon.

changes.title: Trump is still searching for a way out of Iran
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is struggling to find a way out of the conflict with Iran, as voters lose patience with the war and weapons stockpiles dwindle. The path forward remains unclear, even as Trump has privately weighed dropping his long-held requirement for a nuclear deal. Washington is unlikely to accept Iran’s late.

changes.title: Oil rises amid uncertainty over U.S.-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
changes.summary: Oil rose as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not be coming anytime soon.

changes.title: Haunted by Hoover, Trump searches for an endgame in Iran
changes.summary: President Trump is confronting a question that has haunted presidents throughout history: how a war - that has gone on longer than predicted - can reshape a presidency. (Image credit: KENT NISHIMURA).

changes.title: Pakistan says new defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey is 'purely defensive' and open to others
changes.summary: The landmark Mecca Joint Defense Agreement was signed on Friday as the three countries seek to deepen security cooperation amid heightened tensions between the United States and Iran.

changes.title: Iran sets steep demands to reopen Hormuz despite hopes Oman deal could break impasse
changes.summary: There are no ongoing negotiations between Tehran and Washington, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Sunday, after Tehran set out a steep series of demands for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Iran Taps Longtime I.R.G.C. Commander Mohsen Rezaei to Top Security Post
changes.summary: The appointment of Mohsen Rezaei as secretary of the Supreme National Security Council suggests that Iran’s old guard is consolidating power.

changes.title: Iran Says There’s Still No Deal on Reopening the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: Iran is issuing a new set of demands to President Donald Trump and American negotiators before it will consider re-opening the vital Strait of Hormuz. The demands require the United States to never threat or insult Iran, withdraw military forces and compensate for damages during the war. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for.
